name: Revolution IRC
tagline: Chat on IRC with a clean, modern app
description:
Revolution IRC is a modern app for joining IRC chat rooms, the old-school text chat networks still used by many open-source and tech communities. It gives IRC, which normally feels stuck in the past, a fresh and easy-to-use design on your phone.

Whether you're keeping up with a favorite open-source project or just want to hang out in a chat room, Revolution IRC makes it simple.
